outlook.discussion: 1. Western Central Pacific: Showers and thunderstorms are a little better organized in association with a broad area of low pressure located just west of the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll. Some development of this system is possible over the next few days while it moves east-northeastward at 10 to 15 mph. By the middle of next week, however, strong upper-level winds should limit any additional development. Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.
